items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I had the pleasure of knowing her and meeting her and she did -- she just did wonders with my son, you know.

ctx.x: Maria's sister Charlotte was named after her. She was a wonderful woman. I had the pleasure of knowing her and meeting her and she did -- she just did wonders with my son, you know. She took a great deal of interest, not only in my son, but in all children. She was just a born educator, you know. She was a wonderful woman.
But anyway, this all happened, and of course the folks back there were looking at the show, and all over the country, it was seen all over the country.
